get.description:
The account the token or session belongs to. Its time zone decides where the account's local days begin and end.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `profile:read`, or a signed-in session.

Checks the API token the request carries and describes it: its name, scopes, devices and expiry. A token that is refused gets the usual 401 instead, so this is the call to test a token with, or to find out when it expires. Only a token can be verified: a signed-in session gets 400.

**Access:** any API token, whatever its scopes; not a session.

200.description: The API token that made the request.

get.description:
Every device of the account — or, for a token limited to some devices, those — with its status, battery, trip in progress and point counts, and with its latest position for a credential that holds `locations:read`.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `devices:read`, or a signed-in session.

One device, as in the list.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `devices:read`, or a signed-in session.

schema.description: The device's id.

patch.description:
Renames the device, switches its silence alerts or queues a settings preset for Overland. Its credentials are out of reach: no token can replace a device's access token or delete a device, which takes a signed-in session. The answer has the device and its settings after the change; the device's position only for a credential with `locations:read`.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `devices:write`, or a signed-in session.

schema.description: The device's id.

get.description:
Where the device is now: the newest position it reported (a stored point or the phone's current position) with accuracy, speed and course, and its last battery reading. `location` is null until the device sends its first position.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `locations:read`, or a signed-in session.

schema.description: The device's id.

location.description: Null until the device has sent a position.

get.description:
The points one device recorded, exactly as the phone sent them (no smoothing, no map matching), oldest first and a page at a time: follow `nextCursor` until it is null. `from` and `to` narrow the range. A phone uploads when it can, so points may arrive later than newer ones: to keep a copy current, ask again for a range that overlaps the end of the last one.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `locations:read`, or a signed-in session.

get.description:
How many points were ever recorded in each cell of a viewport, summed over the devices: the cells get smaller as `zoom` grows. Counted as points arrive, so it costs the same for a day of data as for ten years.

**Access:** an API token with the scope `history:read`, or a signed-in session.

This API described in OpenAPI 3.1, for code generators, HTTP clients and this reference. It changes only with a new release of Trail: cache it for five minutes and revalidate with `If-None-Match`.

**Access:** public, no credential needed.

bearer.description:
An API token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer trlk_…`. Its scopes decide what it may do; an operation lists the scopes that grant access to it.

| Scope | Allows |
|---|---|
| `profile:read` | Read the account's name and time zone. |
| `devices:read` | List the devices with their name, status, last-seen time and battery, not where they are. |
| `devices:write` | Rename devices, switch their alerts and queue settings presets; never their tokens. |
| `locations:read` | Read positions: where the devices are now and where they have been (points, tracks, the timeline). |
| `locations:write` | Correct how you travelled (transport mode overrides). |
| `history:read` | Read visits, trips, daily statistics, activity and the heatmap. |
| `people:read` | See the people who share their location with you. |
| `shares:read` | List your shares, the ones you receive and your public links. |
| `shares:write` | Start and stop sharing, hide people and manage public links. |
